remaining_findings.title: P8 seal trusts a stale unchanged flag
remaining_findings.evidence: seal checks each P8_COPIAS.unchanged boolean but does not rehash P/evidence path against sha256 and previously_indexed_sha256. A copied historical report changed after assembly and before seal could be included in PRONTO without a fresh P8 discrepancy.
remaining_findings.suggestion: At seal, require sha(P/x[path]) == x[sha256] == x[previously_indexed_sha256] for every P8 row.

remaining_findings.title: Runtime does not bind declaration kinds to BENCH_DECL
remaining_findings.evidence: The parser reads kind and rejects axiom but does not compare each kind to unit.declaration_kinds. A package internally repinned with theorem changed to definition in the unit metadata may pass while reporting an inaccurate kind.
remaining_findings.suggestion: Collect log kinds and require exact equality to unit.declaration_kinds; add a repinned_bad_kind synthetic control.
